shellCommands.command: git status --short && git log --oneline | head -5 && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -path ./.git -prune -o -type f -print | head -100
for f in package.json index.html tsconfig.json vite.config.ts .gitignore src/App.tsx src/main.tsx src/vite-env.d.ts; do echo "=== $f"; cat "$f"; echo; done
ls node_modules 2>/dev/null | head -3; node -v; npm -v; (npm ci --no-audit --no-fund 2>&1 | tail -5)

cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | grep '"version"'; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster/ 2>/dev/null; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components | head -80; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster && cat Toaster.d.ts types.d.ts hooks/useToaster.d.ts ToasterComponent/ToasterComponent.d.ts Provider/ToasterProvider.d.ts 2>/dev/null; ls ToasterComponent Provider hooks
cat hooks/useToaster.js Provider/ToasterProvider.js ToasterComponent/ToasterComponent.js Toaster.js | head -250; cat constants.js

grep -rn "autoHiding" --include=*.js . | grep -v map | head; grep -n "autoHiding\|export" ../Button/Button.d.ts | head -5; cat ../Button/Button.d.ts | head -60; which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome 2>/dev/null; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm && grep -n "Toaster" components/index.d.ts index.d.ts 2>/dev/null; grep -n "DEFAULT_TIMEOUT" components/Toaster/Toast/Toast.js | head -3
cd /home/sandbox/workspace && npm run build 2>&1 | tail -25
(ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null; which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome firefox 2>/dev/null; ls node_modules | grep -i -E "playwright|puppeteer|jsdom|happy" ; echo done)
cd /tmp && mkdir -p pwcheck && cd pwcheck && npm init -y >/dev/null && timeout 240 npm i playwright@1 --no-audit --no-fund 2>&1 | tail -2 && timeout 280 npx playwright install chromium 2>&1 | tail -3

(sudo -n true 2>/dev/null && echo SUDO_OK) ; (timeout 200 sudo -n apt-get install -y -q libglib2.0-0 libnss3 libnspr4 libatk1.0-0 libatk-bridge2.0-0 libcups2 libxkbcommon0 libxcomposite1 libxdamage1 libxrandr2 libgbm1 libpango-1.0-0 libcairo2 libasound2 >/tmp/apt.log 2>&1; echo exit=$?; tail -3 /tmp/apt.log)
whoami; id -u; (timeout 200 apt-get install -y -q libglib2.0-0 >/tmp/apt.log 2>&1; echo exit=$?; tail -2 /tmp/apt.log); find / -name "libglib-2.0.so*" 2>/dev/null | head -3

cp package.json /tmp/pkg.bak && cp package-lock.json /tmp/lock.bak && timeout 280 npm i --no-save --no-audit --no-fund jsdom@25 2>&1 | tail -2; cmp -s package.json /tmp/pkg.bak && echo pkg-unchanged; cmp -s package-lock.json /tmp/lock.bak && echo lock-unchanged
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster && sed -n 1,140p Toast/Toast.js
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/hooks/private && ls; cat useCloseOnTimeout/*.js 2>/dev/null || grep -rl "useCloseOnTimeout" . | head -3
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster && cat ToastList/ToastList.js | head -120
timeout 200 npx vitest run -c vitest.tmp.config.mts src/__tmp_toast.test.tsx 2>&1 | grep -v "npm warn" | tail -40

pkill -f "vite --port 5173" ; rm -f src/__tmp_toast.test.tsx vitest.tmp.config.mts && rm -rf dist && timeout 200 npm prune --no-audit --no-fund 2>&1 | grep -v "npm warn" | tail -2; cmp -s package.json /tmp/pkg.bak && echo pkg-unchanged; cmp -s package-lock.json /tmp/lock.bak && echo lock-unchanged; git status --short; timeout 200 npm run build 2>&1 | grep -E "built|error" ; rm -rf dist; git status --short

for p in /proc/[0-9]*; do if tr '\0' ' ' < $p/cmdline 2>/dev/null | grep -q "vite --port 5173"; then kill ${p#/proc/} && echo killed ${p#/proc/}; fi; done; cd /home/sandbox/workspace && git diff --stat && cat src/App.tsx
git diff --stat && ls src && cat src/App.tsx
timeout 200 npm run build 2>&1 | grep -E "built|error|TS[0-9]" ; rm -rf dist; git status --short
